patch_description: The batch-based pipeline loop serialized SSD reads and GPU copies - it submitted all reads in a batch, waited for all completions, then did all GPU copies. This prevented any overlap between I/O and compute. Fixed by implementing a sliding-window approach: prime the ring with initial reads, then for each completion immediately issue the GPU copy and submit the next read. This overlaps SSD I/O with GPU DMA transfers. Also increased PIPELINE_RING_SIZE from 8 to 16 to better saturate the NVMe queue depth.
